_note: !!! CAUTION: THIS TALKS TO THE REAL AQAWAN 1 PAC (through the tunnel on 127.0.0.1:7100). !!!
The legacy dome daemon (domeControl.py on the site gateway) is connected to this PAC and is mission-critical.
It is NOT yet known whether the PAC tolerates a second client. Do not start this until JDE has decided it may be tried, and stop it at the first sign of trouble in the legacy dome log.

read_only: this server sends the PAC only STATUS, GET_FAULTS and GET_ERRORS (the client refuses anything else before the wire); OpenShutter, CloseShutter, AbortSlew, Heartbeat and ClearFaults are refused. It CANNOT CLOSE THE ENCLOSURE: never point a safety supervisor at it as its only dome.
status_max_age 10: at most one STATUS per 10 s from robofast, whatever polls this server.
allow_hardware true is useless without --hardware on the command line:
docs/remote.md (order of services, the tunnel), docs/aqawan.md.
name: aqawan1
